ns2:course.label: Food Chemistry
ns2:course.description: Examines the chemical aspects of major food components; water, carbohydrates, proteins, and lipids; properties of pigments, salts, and food dispersions. Undergraduate Food Science majors must enroll concurrently in FSHN 416. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CHEM 232.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CHEM 232.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
